purpose: Machine-readable home for `captured_under`: which published runtime_identity a piece of accepted evidence was captured under. THIS FILE IS THE MECHANICAL AUTHORITY for staleness; the claim-state registry remains the sole writer of object STATE (doc structure contract C5.1).
why_a_sidecar: The same reason `declaration_policy_binding_v1` is a sidecar: nothing in this repository should parse Markdown tables to reach a fail-closed verdict. A partial Markdown parser trusted with authority found a new way to be wrong every hardening round. The registry keeps the prose and the state; this file keeps the digests.

consumption_rule.current: every bound axis equals the published identity
consumption_rule.behavior_preserving: `implementation` and/or `environment` differ while `behavior` and `decision_surface` are equal — the online track moved without changing policy-visible behavior; the binding stays valid
consumption_rule.stale: `decision_surface` or `behavior` differs — consumers are inadmissible until re-attested. This is a version-lag flag, not a retraction: a closure established on the old identity remains true of that identity (fidelity protocol § 2.8).
consumption_rule.unattested: captured_under is null — the evidence predates published identities and makes no substrate-version claim. Absence is never read as agreement.

bindings.note: No retroactive claim. The five spent H0 chains produced no faithful capture, so there is no capture to bind. A binding appears here only if an H2 Layer-M measurement reaches terminal 5 and an owner accepts it.
